name: Shizu Melonis
source:
"Hey, doing okay? I'm Shizu. I'm in the running for leadership in Aphesis. I'm just like Liliana. Those who believe will be saved!"

A member of the Aphesis Cult and a colleague of [url=/c160635]Liliana[/url]. She is high-ranking and leads other cult members.

She constantly wears a friendly smile. She's well-versed in the cult's doctrines and extremely knowledgeable about the intricate workings of the world.

Liliana relies on her deeply. If you were to make her your enemy... she'd be quite a formidable opponent.

[From [url=https://ifi.games/deathendz/chara/?page=category4&ch=shizu]official website[/url]]
